title: sida rhombifolia var. retusa
intro: Sida rhombifolia var. retusa, commonly known as 'sida retusa', is a variety of the sida rhombifolia plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the Malvaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida rhombifolia var. retusa include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
